# Ecco trace

When the user asks to share or save the current session, find its session.json file in ~/.fx/sessions and run:

`"@@ecco@@" "traces" "push" "--from" "fx" "--api" "@@api@@" "--home" "@@home@@" "--transcript" "<session.json>"`

Do not upload a session without the user's request.
